body:
Every ecosystem runs on energy from the sun.

- Producers, like plants and algae, use sunlight, air and water to make their own food.
- Consumers eat other living things. Herbivores eat plants, carnivores eat animals, and omnivores eat both.
- Decomposers, like fungi, bacteria and worms, break down dead things and return their matter to the soil.

A food chain shows one path: grass → rabbit → fox. The arrow points to the one that does the eating.

A food web connects many food chains. Change one living thing, and the whole web can change.
title: Who Eats Whom?
